caveats: Point-in-time reads at block 219,162,280; fork tests run at blocks ~219,165k-219,168k. State drifts slowly (deposit/redeem-only protocol).
Bridged assets (USDC.e/USDT.e/WBTC.e) marked at par for H-O valuation; a bridge discount would lower holder recovery, not attacker extraction.
Oracle contract is unverified; its non-keeper functions were probed live (all setter paths gated), not source-reviewed.
Borrow caps are one admin transaction away from being raised; the entire class would re-open if that happened (watch _setMarketBorrowCaps).
The oracle owner being a single EOA is a privileged-key risk (P), not E-U.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from Aurigami: all 14 markets are supply/redeem-only because every borrowCap is 1 wei (borrow(1) reverts 'market borrow cap reached'), the oracle is keeper-gated with accurate fresh prices, the whole liquidatable book is $30.73 of dust ($0.84 max bonus), and the $1.12M of cToken cash is holder-recoverable (H-O) rather than attacker-takeable.
